title: Built with Claude — Project Showcase Megathread
author: MixAndMortarDev
selftext:
I can't code at all — and I made a 3D browser game anyway. Claude wrote every line.



Mix & Mortar: Overcooked-style chaos on a New York construction site. Mix mortar and concrete, cut beams, haul bricks and deliver orders before grumpy foreman Boris loses it. Every order adds a piece to a real house rising behind the fence — from a tiny Staten Island home to a Manhattan tower.



How it was made: all the code (three.js, \~40 files), 3D characters, animations, menus, tests — Claude. My part: the idea, "this looks ugly, fix it" feedback, lots of playtesting. Music is CC0, sounds and the cover were AI-generated.



Early version — honest feedback very welcome: what's fun, what's confusing, where you got stuck.



Play free in your browser: [https://mneho333.itch.io/mix-and-mortar](https://mneho333.itch.io/mix-and-mortar)

replies.author: MixAndMortarDev
replies.body: Nice, thanks for sharing! Love seeing what people pull off with these tools. How did you split the work between Gemini, Claude and Codex — did each one handle different parts? For Mix & Mortar it was Claude for basically everything (code, 3D characters, animation, tests), I just kept saying "make it prettier" until it was 🙂 If you give it a try, I'd love to hear what felt off!
